page.layout: One column of running text, with section letters and the numeral "II." in the left margin. The catchword is at the lower right. The right edge shows part of the neighbouring page, which is not transcribed.

main_text.p: eNeque licere ulli ecclesiæ, pontifici, concilio ullius hominis libros vel traditiones prædictis adæquare.
fSimiliter ostende prædictorum scripturæ librorum lectionem & meditationem esse æquè concessam, imò verò mandatam omnibus hominibus, tum laicis, tum clericis, qui dicuntur.
gEâ linguâ quam, quisque novit, etiam vernaculâ.
hPræterea omnia ad salutem necessaria illic proponi sufficienter, & perspicuè satis.
II.Deinde disputa contra auctoritatem & decreta vel traditiones sedis pontificiæ, ejusque conjuratorum, & doceto[?].
iTraditiones Romanensium, extra & præter scripturam propheticam & apostolicam nullam apud pios auctoritatem promereri.
k[?]Neque sufficere ad pacandu[?] conscientias, auctoritate antiquitatis, conciliorum, & ecclesiæ doctorum.

page.notes: The section letters in the left margin (e, f, g, h, i, k) are reference marks standing beside their paragraphs, and some of them are uncertain. The "k" mark and "pacandu" are doubtful readings. "doceto" is doubtful. Small faint marks in the left margin and the show-through from the other side are not transcribed. The right page is cut off at the scan edge, so only its margin is visible and it is left out.
